videos.title: DIY Accounting Submit: view your VAT obligations
videos.description: DIY Accounting Submit is a free tool for sending VAT returns to HMRC under Making Tax Digital. This video shows signing in, taking out a day pass, and asking HMRC which VAT periods are due on a VAT registration number. It's a real recording of the live product, not a mockup or a design draft. Try it yourself at https://submit.diyaccounting.co.uk.

videos.title: DIY Accounting Submit: submit a VAT return to HMRC
videos.description: DIY Accounting Submit is a free tool for sending VAT returns to HMRC under Making Tax Digital. This video shows signing in, taking out a day pass, checking which VAT period is open, then filling in the nine boxes and submitting the return to HMRC. It's a real recording of the live product, not a mockup or a design draft. Try it yourself at https://submit.diyaccounting.co.uk.

videos.title: DIY Accounting Submit: view a submitted VAT return
videos.description: DIY Accounting Submit is a free tool for sending VAT returns to HMRC under Making Tax Digital. This video shows signing in, taking out a day pass, and opening a VAT return already on file with HMRC to read back all nine boxes. The return on screen was filed earlier, off camera, with Box 6 (total sales excluding VAT) at £5,000. It's a real recording of the live product, not a mockup or a design draft. Try it yourself at https://submit.diyaccounting.co.uk.

videos.title: DIY Accounting Submit: view Self Assessment businesses (sandbox)
videos.description: DIY Accounting Submit is a free tool for filing Self Assessment under Making Tax Digital for Income Tax. This video shows signing in, taking out Resident ITSA, and asking HMRC which self-employment and property businesses it holds against a National Insurance number. This is a sandbox preview, recorded against HMRC's test environment, not a live filing. Try the VAT side of the product now at https://submit.diyaccounting.co.uk.
